response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and infrastructure work, which makes him significantly overqualified for an entry-level Junior/Mid-Level Fullstack role. While his technical breadth (TypeScript, Node.js, React/Ember, databases, AWS/Kubernetes exposure) covers the required stack well, the seniority mismatch raises concerns about role satisfaction, compensation expectations, and retention in a junior position.
strengths: Deep, broad fullstack experience spanning 15+ years across multiple languages and platforms
Strong TypeScript/Node.js background plus React and Ember.js experience aligning with core stack needs
Demonstrated exposure to Kubernetes, AWS-adjacent tooling (AWS CDK), and scalable architecture
concerns: Vastly overqualified for a junior/mid-level, entry-level position — likely mismatch in role expectations and compensation
No explicit PostgreSQL experience (mostly MongoDB/MySQL), and no direct mention of Nest.js
Long, senior-heavy career trajectory raises risk of quick turnover or dissatisfaction in a junior IC role
